name: Uroku Shiki
source:
Element: Beryllium
Rank: 純弐位
Hobby/Skill: Trap development

A realist who is sharp and perceptive.
He is friendly on the outside, but never shows his true feelings and is elusive.
Even though he won't talk about his past, he will always lay flowers at the memorial of "Dead Matter" victims.
